# Tree shapes for scripts/preflight.sh. test-preflight.sh builds each case's entries in a new, empty working
# directory outside any repository and runs preflight there, with no arguments, under each bash.
# One case per line: <exit status><TAB><the one stderr line, empty for status 0><TAB><entry>[<TAB><entry>...].
# An entry is d:<path> (a directory), f:<path> (an empty file), j:<path>=<text> (a file holding <text>) or
# l:<path>=<target> (a symbolic link to <target>); the directories above <path> are made too. A status-64
# case prints nothing on stdout; a status-0 case prints nothing on stderr and ends with the ok line. No case
# changes anything in the working directory.
